title: Model Capacity Determines Grokking through Competing Memorisation and Generalisation Speeds
abstract: arXiv:2605.09724v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing accounts of grokking explain the phenomena in terms of mechanistic frameworks such as circuit efficiency or lazy-to-rich transitions. However, despite a known dependence between grokking and model size, how model capacity shapes grokking remains an open question. We give an information-theoretic account of this relationship on the task of modular arithmetic, showing that grokking does not immediately occur when a model becomes large enough to memorise the training set, but rather emerges as the outcome of a competition between two measurable timescales: a memorisation speed $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ and a generalisation speed $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$, both of which are functions of model parameter count $P$. Adapting the information capacity framework of Morris et al. translated_title: 模型容量通过记忆化与泛化速度的竞争决定顿悟现象
translated_abstract: 现有关于顿悟（grokking）现象的解释大多基于电路效率或从懒惰到富饶转变等机制性框架。然而，尽管已知顿悟与模型规模之间存在依赖关系，模型容量如何塑造顿悟仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们在模运算任务上对这一关系给出了信息论层面的解释，表明当模型变得足够大以至于能够记住训练集时，顿悟并不会立即出现，而是作为两个可测量时间尺度之间竞争的结果而涌现：记忆化速度 $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ 与泛化速度 $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$，二者均为模型参数量 $P$ 的函数。借助并改进 Morris 等人（2025）的信息容量框架，我们在同等复杂度的随机标签数据上估计 $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$，在模运算任务本身上估计 $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$，并表明顿悟在……时涌现（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一个信息论解释框架，指出顿悟现象并非在模型容量足以记住训练集时立即发生，而是由记忆化速度与泛化速度这两个随参数量变化的可测量时间尺度的相对竞争所决定。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an information-theoretic account showing that grokking emerges not immediately when a model is large enough to memorise the training set, but as the outcome of a competition between two measurable timescales—memorisation speed and generalisation speed, both functions of parameter count.
